subject: FinTechCorp — Security discovery: incident response, breach notification & BCP evidence request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-05T22:12:00Z
Subject: FinTechCorp discovery recap — IR / breach notification / BCP next steps

Hi Alex / Priya — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our security/compliance discussion so we stay aligned: 

1) SOC 2 status: you asked for our most recent attestation and a redacted report. I can share the redacted report and summary of scope.

2) Incident response & breach notification: you wanted our IR playbook excerpts, expected timelines for detection/notification, and who your primary security contact will be.

3) BCP/DR evidence: you asked for RTO/RPO targets and recent DR test summary (tabletop or failover tests).

4) Vendor security questionnaire: please confirm whether you want us to start with your standard questionnaire or the short security checklist. We can fill your DocuSign/portal or provide our answers in a shared doc.

Attachments: I attached a short excerpt from our IR playbook for context (Redwood_IR_playbook_excerpt.pdf).

Next steps I propose: 
- I will loop in our security and compliance leads to provide the redacted SOC 2 and DR test summary (target: by EOD Monday).
- Please confirm the preferred delivery method for the vendor questionnaire (link/attachment/portal).
- Please share any specific regulatory constraints (e.g., HIPAA scope, data residency) we should be aware of when preparing evidence.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Attachment: Redwood_IR_playbook_excerpt.pdf (PDF, 180KB, redacted excerpts)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechcorp.com>, security@fintechcorp.com
Date: 2027-06-06T09:34:00Z
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp discovery recap — IR / breach notification / BCP next steps

Thanks Jordan — useful recap. A few clarifying items from our side after the call: 

- SOC 2: we need a copy of the most recent Type II attestation and a short scope summary. Redacted is fine for public/non-prod data.
- IR timelines: what is your standard detection-to-notification SLA? We operate under a regulatory expectation that we receive notification within 72 hours for incidents that meet our breach criteria. Please confirm Redwood's policy and a contact for notifications.
- BCP/DR evidence: please include RTO/RPO figures for critical services and the last DR/test date and high-level results. A one-page summary is ideal.
- Vendor questionnaire: we'll send our standard security questionnaire (DocuSign link) after we confirm the SOC2 copy.

Also: are there any planned maintenance windows or scheduled degradations that could impact our integration in the next 30 days?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Security, FinTechCorp
alex.johnson@fintechcorp.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-06-09T18:04:00Z
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp discovery recap — SOC 2, IR timeline & BCP evidence (redacted docs)

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks for the follow-up. Per Jordan's note, attaching the requested items for your review: 

Attachments included:
- SOC2_redacted_2026.pdf (redacted Type II attestation and scope summary)
- IR_timeline_draft.xlsx (high-level incident response timeline with notification windows)
- DR_test_summary_2026.pdf (summary of most recent DR tabletop and failover checks; includes RTO/RPO targets)

Notes: 
- SOC2 scope: our attestation covers production inference APIs, billing systems, and relevant platform controls. Sensitive customer identifiers are redacted in the attached PDF.
- Notification policy: Redwood will notify customers and relevant contacts within 72 hours of becoming aware of an incident that meets the customer's breach criteria; for critical incidents we initiate a 24/7 escalation and aim to provide an initial notification within 24 hours with follow-ups. Exact notification timing is governed by incident severity and legal/regulatory requirements.
- BCP/DR: our target RTO for core inference endpoints is 2 hours with an RPO of 15 minutes for stateful replication paths; non-critical background jobs have longer targets. We conducted a mixed tabletop/failover test in 2026-11; summary is in the DR_test_summary_2026.pdf.

Vendor questionnaire: here's a link to a short form that speeds review: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1ExampleVendorQuestionnaire. If you prefer to send your DocuSign/portal link, we will complete that as well.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you need any additional evidence (logs, SOC2 bridge letters, penetration test summaries). Happy to schedule a 30-minute follow-up with our security leads if helpful.

Best — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0147
